subject.title: Exec/tool failures show "(see attached image)" and suppress model response

question: When an exec-like tool error leaves a channel turn with zero user-facing payloads, should OpenClaw emit a generic redacted warning or incomplete-turn fallback instead of preserving the current silent exec-like suppression?
rationale: Current source still suppresses both the exec-like warning and incomplete-turn fallback for this state, and changing it affects user-visible error disclosure and retry semantics.

options.title: Emit generic recovery text
options.body: Show a redacted exec/tool failure warning or incomplete-turn fallback only when no user-facing reply was delivered.

options.title: Keep silent suppression
options.body: Treat the existing exec-like suppression as intentional and close or split the remaining request as not planned.

options.title: Require live repro first
options.body: Leave behavior unchanged until maintainers reproduce the exact Discord, Telegram, or WebChat zero-payload failure on current main.

recommendation.title: Emit generic recovery text
recommendation.body: Show a redacted exec/tool failure warning or incomplete-turn fallback only when no user-facing reply was delivered.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent terminal classifier and current-line history make steipete the best available owner for the product-policy choice.
